question: What are the complete fixed Irf4/Pparg/Rxra/Stat6/Egr2/Arg1 RNA and mapped-region profiles in the non-infectious reference?
decision: Distinguish uniform identity-direction interpretations from target/region heterogeneity in this reference only; no NAM target selection or memory inference.
strongest_rival: Model/annotation choices, compositional normalization, baseline genotype differences and unknown preparation dependence can explain RNA/accessibility patterns.
discriminator: Complete six-literature-target extraction from frozen WT IL4-minus-CTRL and cKO-minus-WT IL4/CTRL estimates, with every mapped region and both mappings/subsets.
exposure_record: All published and aggregate E2/F1/F4 results are exposed. Six targets selected from named literature premises before inspecting saved target outcomes, never on effect/p-value. This is not a favorable selected-feature rescue.
biological_unit: Source-reported cultured-macrophage mouse/preparation within group and assay; exact preparation/litter/batch map remains unknown.
nesting_and_overlap: RNA WT3/group; cKO IL4=3 and CTRL=4; ATAC4/group. Across-condition and cross-assay overlap unknown. Features/regions are dependent observations, not biological replicates.
population_and_selection: Exact six symbol/Ensembl targets in the complete saved eligible E2/F4 universes. Keep both mapping rules and all-annotated/within2kb subsets, all zeros and opposite signs.
contrast: Frozen WT IL4-minus-CTRL at offset1; frozen cKO-minus-WT withinIL4 and withinCTRL; no new interaction or RNA/ATAC subtraction.
endpoint: Copied mean log2(1+CPM) differences and full inherited conditional uncertainty fields; mapped-region sign counts/ranges without activity aggregation.
methods: One-to-one source identifier join, exact frozen-row extraction, many-to-one region join, full parity verification against all copied fields and cardinalities; no count refit.
missingness_and_exclusions: Stop on ambiguous/missing target RNA identity or source mismatch. Absent mapped regions reported as absent coverage, not zero. No significant-peak selection.
multiplicity: No new tests or p-values; all six targets, three contrasts, both mappings and distance subsets reported without ranking.
precision_basis: Inherit WT dependence-model sensitivity envelopes and F4 independence-conditional Welch intervals exactly. Unknown dependence prevents population-CI interpretation; no effect margin or power.
interpretation_limit: Non-infectious BMDM conditional description; no IL13 alveolar switch reproduction, verified regulon, binding, mediation, ARG1 catalysis, NAM maintenance or pathogen-challenge extension.
stop_rule: Stop on hash/identifier/mapping/parity mismatch. Retain all prespecified targets and adverse outcomes. No favorable region selection, scale subtraction, held-source bypass or outcome-based extension.
amendment_reason: Owner-authorized literature-informed target screen, separately scoped from existing frozen results; no prior design is overwritten.
